# Uyir AI Labs

> Uyir AI Labs Private Limited is an AI-native software company in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India (DPIIT-recognised startup, Udyam-registered MSME). It builds its own products and custom software for businesses that run on daily operations.

## Products
- Firro: an AI-native Kitchen OS for subscription and tiffin kitchens — POS, kitchen admin, customer app and delivery app on one system; AI drafts tomorrow's prep from today's subscriptions and people approve it. Status: pilot in Coimbatore.
- Native Nights: a live social space where Tamil-speaking people living abroad meet through small, hosted weekly rooms (4–10 people). Web app live.

## Services
- AI and automation (assistants, agents, workflow automation)
- Web and mobile apps (Flutter, React, PWA)
- SaaS product engineering (multi-tenant, RBAC, offline-first)
- UI/UX and design systems
